sources.title: Animate Dead
markers: | description = Animate a corpse to create an undead servant while not in combat.

summary: Grants physical damage resistance to nearby allied undead and lets you cast Animate Dead once per Long Rest.

fields.Undead Ward: Allied undead gain resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing. The tooltip shows 20 ft. The pinned source reports a 30 ft radius, some summoned fiends also qualify, and Astarion does not benefit.
fields.Animate Dead: Action outside combat. Target a Small or Medium corpse within 10 ft and choose Skeleton or Zombie. Casting Animate Dead again dismisses the previous summon. Recharges on Long Rest.
fields.Base value: 240 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Reported summon behavior: The pinned item source reports that selecting Zombie summons a decaying Newborn Zombie.
